My role

I worked on vehicle driving and steering with wheel colliders, a speedometer, camera-follow behaviour and power-ups. The team included other developers and artists.

Technical approach

The camera followed the car and adjusted around walls. Vehicle movement included limits on rotation and handling for landing after airborne movement. Power-ups added speed and shield behaviour.

Result

This project helped me work with interacting gameplay systems and shared responsibilities in a team.
